about: Registry of verified sources for default parameters. Every entry in "items" was checked against a document that was actually fetched on the retrieval date; "quote" is text copied from that document (regulation quotes were machine-checked against the fetched text; quotes from scanned reports are transcriptions from OCR or page images, as stated in the note). Entries in "unverified" are defaults for which no source could be confirmed — they carry no citation on purpose and must not be presented as sourced.

grades.regulation: binding rule text or official acceptable-means-of-compliance / advisory-circular text
grades.primary-report: the original technical report, paper or official statistic
grades.handbook: MIL handbook/standard, manufacturer datasheet or official guidance handbook
grades.secondary: a public source that reproduces a number whose original (standard, book, report) was not opened
